frontmatter.name: Montlake PTA
frontmatter.description: A warm, practical field guide for the Montlake Elementary community.

body.fontFamily: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif

label.fontFamily: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Segoe UI, sans-serif

philosophy: The site combines the confidence of the Montlake wolf mark with the warmth and clarity of a well-used neighborhood guide. It should feel authored by people who know the school and understand that visitors are often looking for one answer quickly. Utility leads; community character follows.

The visual system uses the wolf logo as an anchor rather than a costume. Deep navy carries structure, school blue marks routes and interaction, cool silver supports quiet surfaces, and warm paper prevents the experience from feeling institutional. Brick appears sparingly to create contrast and human warmth.
keyCharacteristics: open reading surfaces with restrained containers;
circular linework and badge-derived details rather than generic decoration;
community photography that shows real people and programs.

colors.description: The palette is school-aligned, high-contrast, and mostly neutral by area.

colors.name: Montlake Navy
colors.description: primary buttons, structural surfaces, and identity-bearing sections.

colors.name: School Blue
colors.description: badge-derived highlights and quiet visual geometry.

colors.name: Lake Blue
colors.description: links, utility icons, and interactive emphasis.

colors.name: Community Brick
colors.description: rare emphasis, hover states, and human warmth.

colors.name: Brick Wash
colors.description: a quiet page-heading tint for community and event pages.

rules.name: The 80/15/5 Rule
rules.body:
Warm neutrals occupy most of a page, navy provides
structure, and saturated blue or brick stays rare enough to retain meaning.

typography.character: Literata brings a bookish, public-school voice without becoming precious. Atkinson Hyperlegible Next keeps dates, contacts, and instructions easy to distinguish during quick scans.

hierarchy.name: Body
hierarchy.purpose: reading copy with a maximum measure of `68ch`.

rules.name: The Functional Floor Rule
rules.body:
Text that helps a person navigate or act never
drops below `0.8rem`.

layout.description: The site uses a centered `1180px` maximum container with generous section spacing. The homepage begins with a compact operational link rail, then a two-column community-led hero. Repeated parent tasks use open rows and dividers instead of equal-weight cards. Content pages are Read surfaces: a clear page heading, optional “On this page” navigation for long documents, a `68ch` reading measure, and a single help aside. Mobile order always matches document and keyboard order.

elevation.description: The system is flat by default. Borders, background tone, and spacing establish most hierarchy. A single soft ambient shadow is reserved for the hero image and floating navigation menu, where elevation clarifies layering. **The Flat-by-Default Rule.** If spacing and tone can establish the relationship, do not add another card or shadow.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body:
If spacing and tone can establish the relationship,
do not add another card or shadow.

shapes.description: Rounded rectangles support approachable controls and content surfaces. Pill shapes are reserved for buttons. Circular linework references the wolf badge in large identity moments; it is not repeated on every component.

variants.name: Primary
variants.description: Montlake Navy with Warm Paper text.

variants.name: Focus
variants.description: two-tone Warm Paper and Midnight Navy ring that remains visible on both light and dark surfaces.

components.name: Utility Links
components.description: Compact icon-and-label routes use authored outline SVGs, visible secondary text, and borders rather than individual card shadows.

components.name: Cards and Lists
components.description: Cards are used only for genuinely repeatable content such as posts and products. Operational choices and informational groups prefer rows, spacing, and dividers.

components.name: Callouts
components.description: Callouts use Mist Blue, a subtle full border, and a `1rem` radius. Never use a thick colored side tab.

dos: Put calendar, newsletter, after-school, and attendance routes near the top.
Use real Montlake photography with accurate alt text.
Use dividers and proximity before adding containers.
Preserve generous reading measure and strong focus treatment.
Let the logo inform color and geometry subtly.
donts: Reintroduce eyebrow labels above headings or decorative section numbers.
Use equal-size icon cards as default page scaffolding.
Use thick accent borders, side-tab callouts, or emoji as icons.
Make school blue the background of every section.
Let visual order differ from document or keyboard order on mobile.
